description: The console opens already knowing which of the four agents is in trouble. Three healthy, one in Warning, with accuracy, latency, error rate and last-run freshness on every card — no log hunting and no waiting for an operator to complain. Degradation is visible at a glance rather than inferred from the fact that cycles feel slow this week.

A warning that explains itself. The Root Cause Analysis agent is at 1250ms against a 499ms fleet average with a 2.30% error rate, and the P95/P99 tail shows the distribution moved rather than the mean drifting. That distinction is the whole diagnosis: it is a latency problem, not an accuracy collapse, and operators will feel it as slow explanations rather than wrong ones.

One query bar spans the agent runtime, the root-cause distribution and the operator resolution feed at once. Asking what is actually breaking returns System Sync at 45.0% (91 of 202) with the link back to the pattern operators are clearing right now — a correlation that used to mean opening three consoles and trusting your memory of what the third one said.

Forecasts the change before it is made. 1,847 captured corrections at 94% quality project a plus 6 to 8% confidence lift, broken out by improvement area — tax-rule detection +5.2%, promo-code accuracy +3.8%, MRC pattern recognition +2.1% — against four prior retrains that averaged +4.9%. Showing the history next to the forecast is what makes the forecast usable rather than decorative.

Executes the guardrail changes and the model action, and logs both. Moving the High threshold to 92% reprices the whole auto-resolve envelope, so the projected review-load shift is shown before the save; triggering early retraining versions the result and writes the trigger with an operator ID and timestamp. Every configuration change is auditable for the same reason every correction is — someone will ask later what the rules were on the day.

The engine the admin is tuning. Rule and ML layers detect out-of-policy charges across 12.4M accounts; the five charge-type micro-agents work them by charge type and the four pipeline agents detect, score, explain and resolve. The Tax agent runs the lowest average confidence of the five at 79%, which is exactly why Tax Rule Change is the second-largest root cause and where the next retrain is weighted.
